# RoundWonEventArgs.Points property

How many points the winner gets, from 0 to 255. By default, 2 when another slot of the winner's team is still in the round, and 1 otherwise, as the game gives a pair. A score stops at 255.

```csharp
public int Points { get; set; }
```
